source.subject: 68 things to do in London this weekend with the kids (28–29 November)

events.title: Winter Palace at Hampton Court Palace
events.price: Included in palace admission (adults £36, 5–15s £18, under-5s free)
events.blurb: A self-guided Christmas Beast Ball with puppets and performers in Henry VIII's rooms.

events.title: Santa's Grotto at Woolwich Works
events.when: Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November, 10:00–17:45 (plus various other dates until 23 December)
events.age: see FAQs about bringing babies under 1
events.blurb: An affordable 25-minute grotto with letters, puzzles and free photos.

events.title: Pinocchio
events.when: Saturday 28 November–Sunday 3 January, various performance times (see website)
events.price: Standing £5–£10, seated £29–£89 (half-price seated tickets for under-16s)
events.blurb: A musical, puppet-led take on the darker original Pinocchio story.

events.title: Christmas at Twist Museum (20% off with code DADS20)
events.price: 20% off tickets with code DADS20 until 31 December

events.title: Winter Light at the Southbank Centre
events.when: Daily until 10 January, “you can see them whenever we’re open”
events.blurb: Free illuminated artworks across the Southbank, ideal for an early evening outing.

events.title: House of Dreamers (10% off with code DILHOD)
Winter Market at Museum of the Home
events.price: Pay what you can: £0, £2, £4 or £6 per person
events.blurb: Over 50 independent makers selling quirky gifts at a Hackney museum.

events.title: Neon Sun: Roller Circus
events.address: Fireworks Factory, 11 No. 1 Street, Royal Arsenal

events.title: Family Film Club: Chilly Pics Shorts Programme
events.price: Adults £5, under-18s £2.50, plus £1.50 transaction fee per booking (minimum booking of one adult and one child)
